subject: Scheduling: Dedicated/Private demo + EU DPO & APAC security review

Subject: Intro + scheduling: Dedicated/Private deployment walkthrough with regional security reviewers

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the quick interest in a Dedicated/Private walkthrough. To make the session productive we want the EU DPO and your APAC security lead on the call so we can cover data residency, encryption, and network controls in-region.

Proposed slots (converted from PDT):
- Tue Jun 1, 10:00 AM PDT / 19:00 CEST / Wed Jun 2 02:00 JST — (evening EU / late-night APAC)
- Tue Jun 1, 02:00 PM PDT / 23:00 CEST / Wed Jun 2 06:00 JST — (late EU / friendly for APAC morning)
- Wed Jun 2, 08:00 AM PDT / 17:00 CEST / Wed Jun 2 00:00 JST — (US morning / EU late afternoon)

I realize DST shifts this week in the US vs EU may cause confusion; I included explicit conversions. Attached is a short agenda and a SOC2 extract for the topics we'll cover. If none of these work, tell us a 60–75 minute window that fits and we'll adjust.

Attachments: 20260528-demo-agenda.pdf, SOC2-extract.xlsx

Thanks —
Soojin

Hi Soojin —

Thanks, this is helpful. I've looped in our EU DPO, Claire Dubois, and asked our APAC security lead to join (Kenji Sato). A couple of notes:
- Claire prefers earlier EU slots (16:00–18:00 CEST) and will not attend after 19:00 CEST.
- Kenji is in JST and prefers morning local time (08:00–11:00 JST).
- Also: our procurement team (procurement@orbitalhealth.com) may join the tail end for T&Cs.

Of your three proposals, the closest overlap is Tue Jun 1, 02:00 PM PDT / 23:00 CEST / Wed Jun 2 06:00 JST, but Claire flagged that 23:00 CEST is outside her window.

Alternatives we can try:
- Wed Jun 2, 08:00 AM PDT / 17:00 CEST / Wed Jun 2 00:00 JST (Claire can do 17:00 CEST, but Kenji said midnight JST is rough)
- Thu Jun 3, 09:00 AM PDT / 18:00 CEST / Thu Jun 3 01:00 JST (still not ideal for Kenji)

There might be a short pre-call (15 min) between Claire and Jasmine to triage DPO-specific questions if we end up pushing the main demo to a time that prioritizes APAC.

Emma
Enterprise Programs | Orbital Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro + scheduling: Dedicated/Private deployment walkthrough with regional security reviewers

Thanks Emma — helpful context.

Proposal to get to a win for everyone:
1) Schedule a 15-minute pre-read/triage between Claire and Jasmine on Tue Jun 1 at 16:15 CEST / 07:15 PDT (15 min). That keeps it inside Claire's window and keeps Jasmine in the loop.
2) Hold the main walkthrough on Wed Jun 2 at 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / Wed 00:00 JST as a 75-minute session. I appreciate that midnight JST is not ideal — if Kenji can't make the main walkthrough we'll record and schedule a 30-minute APAC follow-up at a JST-friendly hour, but we want Claire there for the main data-residency conversation.

I'll draft calendar invites with automatic timezone conversions and attach the invite ICS. If Claire and Kenji confirm availability (or propose a single swap), we'll finalize.

Action: Claire — can you confirm Tue Jun 1 16:15 CEST for the 15-min pre-call?
Kenji — can you let us know whether Wed Jun 2 00:00 JST is possible, or please propose an alternate JST time on Jun 3 morning?

I'll also surface the specific items Claire requested (data residency mapping, encryption keys, KMS options) in the pre-call agenda.

Thanks —
Soojin

For the main session, I can attend up until 18:45 CEST on Wed Jun 2 (so 17:00–18:45 CEST works). If you intend to run 75 minutes starting at 17:00 CEST we'll be good.
